title: Best 3D printer deal: Save 24% on the Creality K1 Max 3D Printer
excerpt: The printer of the future has been marked down.
content_html:
SAVE OVER $170: The Creality K1 Max 3D Printer is on sale for $548.99 at Amazon, down from the list price of $719. That's a 20% discount.

Credit: Comgrow

$548.99 at Amazon
$719 Save $170.01

The 3D printer may be the printer of the future, but thanks to a heavy discount on the Creality K1 Max 3D Printer at Amazon, the future is very much now. This printer boasts speeds up to 12x faster than other 3D printers and uses AI technology to ensure you get the best-quality models with every print job.

As of Aug. 26, the Creality K1 Max 3D Printer is marked down to $548.99, a 24% saving off the regular list price of $719. Stock for this 3D printer is running low, so you might need to act fast.

This printer is built with AI LiDAR, which scans the first layer of your model and detects any issues. It will then pause the printing job and alert you to any issues, which effectively prevents it from printing defective models. There's also an AI camera for spotting debris and obstructions, while giving you real-time monitoring and time-lapse filming.

In terms of speed, it prints at 600 millimeters per second, with an acceleration of 20,000 millimeters per second. It's packed with even more tech and features, making this a great deal for anyone looking for an advanced 3D printer.
